oncology_cards.title: Canine Osteosarcoma Vaccine Trial
oncology_cards.text: Experimental vaccine trial for dogs recently diagnosed with appendicular osteosarcoma. Two vaccine formulations being assessed. Dogs must be proceeding to surgery with no evidence of metastasis. All breeds eligible.
